title: ADIAS：交互式智能体系统的自动化设计
summary: ADIAS提出以问题为中心的智能体优化方法，通过持久化问题状态指导代码级智能体设计，在五个交互基准上平均提升25.2%，消融实验显示其有效性。
summary_en: ADIAS proposes issue-centric agent optimization with persistent issue state for automated code-level agent design, achieving 25.2% average improvement over baselines on five interactive benchmarks.
